_comment: PRD 6.2: this is the externalized, team-adjustable policy -- scorer.js reads ONLY this file, never hardcodes a number. Mirror this into a Google Sheet tab if you want to demo a live weight change without touching the workflow (see autorelease-ai/README.md).
_manual_review_comment: PRD 6.1: any finding with |deduction| >= this AND confidence:low forces decision=manual_review, overriding the computed band. Checked per-finding before deductions are summed.

secret_detected._note: score deduction is irrelevant -- this category is a BLOCK gate above, which overrides the band entirely regardless of score

_category_notes.infra_failure: 0 deduction on purpose -- an infra flake (runner timeout, network blip) is not evidence about the code. It's still shown in the report so the engineer sees it, just not scored.
_category_notes.unreachable_critical_cve: 0 deduction on purpose -- PRD Q2: failure mode should be over-flagging safe code, not under-flagging dangerous code, and an unreachable finding is NOT hidden from the report even at 0 impact.
_category_notes.code_scanning_alert: CodeQL findings that aren't already covered by the CVE categories (e.g. a code-quality/security-pattern alert unrelated to a dependency).
